user.title: Add an air conditioner
user.description: Set up one AC indoor unit connected through an AB64 box and a Modbus TCP↔RTU gateway (e.g. an Elfin EW11). Name it after the AC unit or the room it's in, not the gateway (see below) — host and port are the gateway's own TCP connection, not the AB64 box's own address, which you'll set in the next step.

data_description.name: Used to generate this AC's entity IDs the first time they're created (e.g. climate.living_room for a name like "Living room") — you can rename the display name later, but not the entity ID itself. A single gateway is often shared by several AC units, each as its own entry, so name this one after the AC/room, not the gateway.
data_description.port: The TCP port your gateway listens on for Modbus — check the gateway's own configuration page, since it varies by brand and model (e.g. an Elfin EW11 defaults to 8899; some other gateways default to 502).

unit.title: Find the unit-id
unit.description: This is the AB64 box's own Modbus address (set via its SW1+SW2 DIP switches) — separate from the gateway's TCP port you entered previously.

data_description.unit_id: Leave blank to scan unit-ids 1-63 (address 0 is skipped — it's the Modbus broadcast address and never responds); this can take up to about a minute. Or enter a specific unit-id to verify it directly, including 0 — if your AB64 is set to address 0, change the DIP switch, since it will never respond on that address. Do not trust the DIP switch reading alone.

select_unit.title: Multiple units found
select_unit.description: More than one unit-id responded on this gateway. Choose the one for this AC unit.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AB64 connection
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway's host/TCP port or the AB64 box's own unit-id for this AC unit. The new values are re-verified by reading register 0 before saving.

data_description.port: The TCP port your gateway listens on for Modbus — check the gateway's own configuration page, since it varies by brand and model (e.g. an Elfin EW11 defaults to 8899; some other gateways default to 502).

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the gateway. Check host, port, and that the gateway is reachable on the network.
error.read_timeout: Connected to the gateway, but the AB64 did not respond on this unit-id. Check wiring, baud rate, and DIP switch address.
error.no_units_found: No unit-id in the 1-63 range responded. Check wiring, baud rate, and that the gateway is bridged to the RS-485 bus.
error.all_units_already_configured: Every unit-id that responded on this gateway is already set up as another entry. Nothing new to add here.
error.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

error.scan_interval_too_low: Poll interval must be at least 10 seconds — this bus may be shared with other AB64 units on the same gateway.
